parameters.message: Hey, your job search results with resume changes are ready in your sheet for today

nodes.name: Append or update row in sheet

parameters.text:
You are an elite technical resume curator. Your goal is to pass ATS screening by carefully selecting the most relevant true experiences from my "Master Resume Bank", ensuring the final output fits on exactly 1 page.

INPUTS:
job_description: {{ $json.Description }}
my_master_resume_bank: 
Technical Skills (Master Dictionary) 

Languages & Core Utilities: 
Python, SQL, JavaScript, Bash, C++, Regex, JSON, LaTeX. 

Generative AI, LLMs & Agentic Frameworks: 
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Multi-Agent Systems, Agentic Workflows, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Prompt Engineering, Amazon Titan Embeddings, Amazon OpenSearch, Vector Similarity Search, BM25 Hybrid Search, AI Safety, Hallucination Prevention, LLMOps, Jina AI, Smart Context Chunking. 

Data Engineering & Big Data Infrastructure: 
AWS Glue, PySpark, Apache Kafka, Amazon Redshift, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Athena, Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold Data Lake), ETL/ELT Pipelines, Relational Database Design (BCNF), Composite Indexing, Data Preprocessing, Feature Extraction. 

Cloud Computing & DevOps (AWS/GCP): 
Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Kubernetes (Amazon EKS), AWS VPC, AWS IAM (Least-Privilege), Terraform, AWS CloudFormation (IaC), Amazon CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, Amazon SageMaker, AWS IoT Core, Amazon EventBridge, AWS Transfer Family (SFTP), CI/CD, Docker. 

Machine Learning, Deep Learning & CV: 
TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, OpenCV, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs / VGG-13), Transfer Learning, Matrix Factorization (SVD), Decision Trees, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naive Bayes, Data Augmentation, Hyperparameter Tuning (L2 Regularization, Dropout, Early Stopping), Predictive Analytics, Recommender Systems, RMSE Metrics, MLOps. 

Backend, APIs & Workflow Orchestration: 
n8n (Workflow Automation), Flask, FastAPI, RESTful APIs, Bootstrap, React, Headless Ingestion, OAuth (Gmail/Google Drive APIs), Slack API Integration, Cron Scheduling, MQTT. 

 

Community Dreams (NGO) 

AI & Automation Engineer | Dec 2025 – Present 

Architected an end-to-end Multi-Agent Grant Intelligence pipeline to automate the ingestion and evaluation of 50+ page government RFPs, reducing manual staff review time by 94% (from 3 hours to 10 minutes per document). 

Engineered robust data ingestion pipelines using Python to securely extract daily grant opportunities directly from Grants.gov REST APIs and RSS feeds, replacing brittle web scrapers with highly reliable data streams. 

Implemented a deterministic Regex-based Python rules engine to act as a hard pre-filter, automatically dropping legally incompatible grants prior to LLM processing to drastically reduce API compute costs. 

Developed an evaluation agent utilizing Google Vertex AI (Gemini) and a custom RAG architecture to cross-reference complex RFP constraints against the NGO’s internal knowledge base of historical metrics and budgets. 

Enforced strict model grounding by configuring the Vertex AI agent to output validated JSON containing match scores, compliance risks, and exact document page citations, enabling rapid human verification and preventing hallucinations. 

Orchestrated a conditional generative workflow where RFPs scoring above an 80% threshold automatically triggered a secondary LLM agent to draft a preliminary Letter of Inquiry (LOI) and a customized missing-information checklist. 

Automated end-to-end document compilation by writing scripts to dynamically inject structured JSON outputs into a LaTeX compiler, generating highly formatted, standardized "Grant Opportunity Brief" PDFs. 

Streamlined enterprise delivery by securely routing all generated PDFs to Amazon S3 and integrating the Slack API to trigger real-time, actionable alerts for NGO directors. 

Designed the architecture strictly as a "Human-in-the-Loop" decision support system, ensuring the AI handled heavy document processing while directors maintained absolute authority over final submissions. 

 

DreamStudio Model.Earth 

AI Engineer | May 2025 – Nov 2025 

Engineered an enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system unifying 10,000+ scattered technical documents in Amazon S3, enabling natural language querying that reduced manual engineering search time by 70%. 

Built automated document ingestion pipelines using AWS Textract to perform robust OCR, successfully extracting clean, usable text from complex, unstructured scanned PDFs and Markdown files. 

Developed advanced data preprocessing workflows natively within Amazon SageMaker using LangChain to clean formatting artifacts, apply metadata tags, and execute context-aware smart chunking (500–1000 tokens, 200-token overlap). 

Transformed unstructured text chunks into high-dimensional semantic representations using Amazon Titan Embeddings, indexing the vectors into an Amazon OpenSearch database for highly scalable storage and retrieval. 

Architected a Hybrid Retrieval search engine within OpenSearch, merging BM25 exact-keyword matching (for technical IDs/acronyms) with Vector Similarity search to achieve sub-second, highly relevant context retrieval. 

Deployed Claude 3.5 Sonnet via AWS Bedrock to serve as the core generative engine, capitalizing on its fast inference latency and superior instruction-following capabilities for complex technical question-answering. 

Eliminated model hallucinations by engineering strict, citation-based prompt templates via LangChain, forcing the AI to ground all answers exclusively in retrieved S3 context and achieving a 97% retrieval precision rate. 

Established comprehensive LLMOps observability by integrating AWS X-Ray to trace millisecond latency across the end-to-end retrieval-generation workflow. 

Monitored system reliability and API performance using Amazon CloudWatch, implementing custom dashboards to track system health, identify query bottlenecks, and debug retrieval failures in real-time. 

 

Big Data Science Research Solutions 

Cloud Data Engineer | Dec 2022 – Jan 2024 

Architected a highly scalable ETL pipeline using AWS Glue (PySpark) to ingest, clean, and deduplicate millions of daily EHR medical records from Amazon S3 into an Amazon Redshift data warehouse, serving as the primary training engine for predictive ML models. 

Engineered a high-throughput, real-time streaming architecture using Apache Kafka deployed on Kubernetes (Amazon EKS) and EC2 to capture live MQTT telemetry data from cellular IoT biosensor patches via AWS IoT Core, reducing data ingestion latency by 60%. 

Designed an event-driven anomaly detection system using Amazon EventBridge and AWS Lambda to instantly scan incoming IoT data streams, automatically routing corrupted or dropped packets to Amazon DynamoDB to enable zero-delay adjustments for downstream ML models. 

Secured highly sensitive healthcare data by provisioning locked-down, private cloud infrastructure within an AWS VPC using Terraform, implementing strict AWS IAM least-privilege roles and automated PII masking protocols to ensure regulatory compliance. 

Facilitated secure external hospital data uploads via AWS Transfer Family (SFTP) into isolated S3 buckets, and configured Amazon Athena to enable data scientists to execute complex, serverless SQL queries directly against raw JSON/CSV files for ad-hoc hypothesis testing. 

Spearheaded a cloud FinOps initiative by profiling and refactoring slow-running PySpark code within AWS Glue jobs and right-sizing underlying EC2 compute nodes, successfully reducing the total AWS cloud compute bill by 15%. 

Automated the provisioning, scaling, and deployment of containerized and serverless data infrastructure using a dual IaC approach with Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, significantly accelerating deployment lifecycles and standardizing environments. 

Ensured highly reliable pipeline execution by implementing comprehensive monitoring, distributed logging, and alerting systems using Amazon CloudWatch dashboards, proactively preventing system crashes across the microservices architecture. 

Bridged the gap between data engineering and machine learning by designing a structured Bronze/Silver/Gold data lake topology, ensuring ML research teams had continuous, high-fidelity access to both historical batch data and low-latency streaming features. 

 

Project 1: Readify – ML Recommendation Engine 

Tech: Python, Flask, Scikit-Learn, Machine Learning, Matrix Factorization, MLOps | Jan 2024 – May 2024 

 

Engineered a full-stack, highly personalized Machine Learning recommendation engine designed to overcome sparse dataset limitations and predict user preferences. 

Designed a rigorous ML evaluation pipeline to benchmark and backtest six distinct classification algorithms, including Decision Trees, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Naive Bayes. 

Solved severe sparse data constraints by implementing Collaborative Filtering via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), utilizing matrix factorization to successfully map latent relationships between users and items. 

Tracked and optimized rigorous statistical performance metrics, analyzing Precision-Recall curves to achieve an RMSE (Root Mean Square Error) of 0.89 and a peak model accuracy of 83%. 

Transitioned the model from a Jupyter Notebook research environment into a production-ready RESTful inference pipeline using Flask, enabling sub-second, dynamic recommendation generation. 

Developed a responsive frontend utilizing Bootstrap and JavaScript to allow users to upload localized datasets and seamlessly interact with the underlying predictive API. 

Project 2: TrueVision – Real-Time Computer Vision System 

Tech: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, Deep Learning, CNNs, VGG-13 | Jun 2024 – Jul 2024 

Architected a real-time Computer Vision accessibility application engineered to provide visually impaired individuals with instant audio feedback translating human facial expressions. 

Designed and trained a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based on the VGG-13 architecture to classify complex, nuanced human emotions using the 36,000+ image FER2013 dataset. 

Overcame strict data limitations and lighting variance by applying aggressive Data Augmentation techniques and utilizing Transfer Learning from pre-trained ImageNet model weights. 

Prevented severe neural network overfitting by implementing mathematical constraints including L2 Regularization, tuning Dropout rates to 0.5, and utilizing validation-loss Early Stopping. 

Successfully forced the network to learn robust, generalized facial features, achieving a peak evaluation accuracy of 78% and reducing false positives on highly nuanced emotions (e.g., fear vs. disgust) by 18%. 

Integrated the optimized deep learning model with OpenCV to capture and process live video streaming feeds, ensuring low-latency, real-time edge inference. 

Project 3: StreamFlix – ML Feature Pipeline & Churn Analytics 

Tech: SQL, Relational Databases, Data Engineering, Query Profiling, Predictive Analytics |Jan 2024 – May 2024 

Engineered a high-performance predictive analytics pipeline designed to identify at-risk users, calculate Customer Lifetime Value (CLV), and drive Customer Churn prevention models. 

Architected a highly normalized, Boyce-Codd Normal Form (BCNF) relational database to systematically track millions of customer interactions, billing histories, and product subscriptions. 

Conducted extensive query execution plan analysis to identify heavy data retrieval bottlenecks caused by complex SQL joins during ML feature extraction. 

Strategically eliminated expensive sequential table scans by implementing Composite Indexing across heavily joined columns (CustomerID, SubscriptionStartDate). 

Drastically improved database retrieval speeds through targeted indexing, reducing complex query execution time by over 50% (from 6.7 milliseconds down to 3.1 milliseconds). 

Ensured seamless, near real-time data availability for downstream Data Scientists, bridging the gap between raw relational data and high-fidelity machine learning feature pipelines. 

 

Project 4: AutoApply AI – Autonomous Agentic Workflow 

Tech: n8n, Google Vertex AI (Gemini), JavaScript, REST APIs, Jina AI, Regex, LaTeX | Apr 2026 – Present 

Architected an autonomous Agentic AI workflow utilizing n8n to orchestrate end-to-end job sourcing, semantic evaluation, and dynamic document generation, eliminating 3+ hours of manual daily processing. 

Engineered headless data ingestion pipelines leveraging the Jina AI API to reliably extract clean, semi-structured text from complex web pages and LinkedIn job postings, bypassing traditional scraping bottlenecks. 

Designed a deterministic JavaScript and Regex rules engine to act as a pre-LLM firewall, instantly rejecting non-compliant (1099/C2C) opportunities to guarantee visa constraints and drastically reduce API compute costs. 

Orchestrated a multi-agent evaluation framework using Google Vertex AI (Gemini 2.5 Pro), deploying an "Evaluator Agent" to semantically score job requirements against a master historical database of skills and experiences. 

Enforced strict zero-hallucination constraints on a secondary "Tailor Agent" through advanced prompt engineering, transforming matched data into highly structured JSON outputs without fabricating technical claims. 

Automated end-to-end document rendering by writing scripts to dynamically map AI-generated JSON outputs into LaTeX templates, invoking external REST APIs to compile pixel-perfect, ATS-compliant PDFs. 

Streamlined delivery and monitoring by integrating Google Drive/Sheets APIs and Gmail OAuth to securely route finalized PDFs, log pipeline metrics, and trigger real-time notifications for high-confidence matches. 

Implemented robust scheduling using cron-based triggers to execute the headless pipeline at standard intervals, ensuring continuous, automated lead generation and error-handling without manual intervention. 

Education:
State University of New York at Buffalo | Jan 2024 – May 2025
Master of Science in Computer Science

IIITDM Jabalpur | Jul 2019 – May 2023
Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science and Engineering

Certifications:
AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate | Issued: Mar 2024 | Credential ID: 65b51979b0c548cdbc8472fd6a3c2034

STRICT CURATION RULES (ANTI-HALLUCINATION):
1. SELECT EXACTLY 3 EXPERIENCES: Choose the 3 jobs from my Master Bank that best align with the JD. 
2. SELECT EXACTLY 2 PROJECTS: Choose the 2 projects from my Master Bank that best align with the JD.
3. SELECT EXACTLY 3 BULLETS PER ITEM: For each chosen job and project, select exactly 3 bullet points from my Master Bank that contain the highest density of keywords found in the JD. 
4. NO CREATIVE WRITING: Do not invent new skills, metrics, or technologies. You may lightly trim the selected bullets for brevity to fit on one page, but the core facts must remain identical to the Master Bank.
5. NO TITLE INFLATION: You must use my exact Job Titles, Companies, Tech, and Dates exactly as they appear in the Master Bank.
6. DYNAMIC SKILLS EXTRACTION: Review the Master Bank "Technical Skills" section. Select a total of 15 to 20 skills that best match the Job Description and categorize them strictly into the 6 JSON buckets below.

FORMAT: Output NOTHING but a raw JSON object. Do NOT use markdown code fences. Do NOT echo the inputs. Escape all internal quotes.

SCHEMA:
{
  "summary": "Crisp 3-line summary tailored to the JD based ONLY on the true experience in my bank.",
  "skills_languages": "Python, SQL, JavaScript...",
  "skills_cloud_devops": "AWS S3, Terraform, Docker...",
  "skills_data_engineering": "Apache Kafka, PySpark, AWS Glue...",
  "skills_genai_llms": "LangChain, RAG, AWS Bedrock...",
  "skills_ml_cv": "TensorFlow, OpenCV, Scikit-Learn...",
  "skills_backend_apis": "n8n, FastAPI, REST APIs...",
  "experiences":[
    {
      "title": "[Exact Title selected from Master Bank]",
      "company": "[Exact Company selected from Master Bank]",
      "dates": "[Exact Dates selected from Master Bank]",
      "location": "Remote",
      "bullets": [
        "[Selected bullet 1]", 
        "[Selected bullet 2]", 
        "[Selected bullet 3]"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "projects":[
    {
      "title": "[Exact Title selected from Master Bank]",
      "tech": "[Exact Tech selected from Master Bank]",
      "dates": "[Exact Dates selected from Master Bank]",
      "bullets":[
        "[Selected bullet 1]", 
        "[Selected bullet 2]", 
        "[Selected bullet 3]"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

TASKS:
1) CHAIN OF THOUGHT ANALYSIS:
   Parse `job_description` into `job_analysis` (extracting tech stack, responsibilities, years of exp).
   Parse `my_resume` into `resume_analysis` (extracting core skills, domains, accomplishments).

2) SEMANTIC HARD REJECT (Visa & Enrollment):
   Analyze the JD for strict constraints. Set `semantic_hard_reject` to true ONLY if:
   - "No sponsorship", "Will not sponsor now or in future", "Must be US Citizen/Green Card holder".
   - "C2C only", "Corp-to-Corp", "1099", "Independent Contractor".
   - The job explicitly states "Must be currently enrolled in school" or "Pursuing a degree". 
   *(Note: If it is an internship, but does NOT explicitly require current school enrollment, leave `semantic_hard_reject` as false).*
   If rejected, provide a short 1-sentence `reject_reason`. Otherwise, set it to "Clean".

3) ROOT-CAUSE SCORING (integer 0–100):
   Compare your analysis. Calculate strictly using this ATS rubric:
   - Core Tech Stack & Keywords (40 pts): Exact matches between JD and Resume.
   - Applied Engineering & Impact (30 pts): Does the resume show production-level execution (APIs, RAG, pipelines) rather than just toy projects?
   - Years of Experience Alignment (20 pts): Does my ~3.5 years of enterprise/academic experience meet the JD's requirement? 
   - Education & Certifications (10 pts): Do I meet the degree (M.S. CS) and certification (AWS) requirements?

STRICT CONTENT RULES:
- Every array element must be a short phrase (≤ 140 chars).
- Escape all quotes (") as (\") inside JSON values. No trailing commas.

SCHEMA:
```json
{
  "job_analysis": {
    "title": "",
    "company": "",
    "must_have_skills":[],
    "years_of_experience": "",
    "tech_stack": []
  },
  "resume_analysis": {
    "core_skills":[],
    "tools_tech": {
      "programming_languages": [],
      "cloud_devops":[]
    }
  },
  "semantic_hard_reject": false,
  "reject_reason": "Clean",
  "match_score": 0,
  "score_explanation":[
    { "category": "Core Tech Stack (40 pts)", "score": 0, "evidence": "..." },
    { "category": "Applied Engineering & Impact (30 pts)", "score": 0, "evidence": "..." },
    { "category": "Years of Experience Alignment (20 pts)", "score": 0, "evidence": "..." },
    { "category": "Education & Certifications (10 pts)", "score": 0, "evidence": "..." }
  ]
}
END_OF_JSON
